searched.title: Introduction to Bambu Nozzles | Bambu Lab Wiki
searched.note: Read in full from the cached HTML (the cached .txt omits the tab panels). The "X1/P1 Series Nozzle" panel and the compatibility rows "X1C Hotend" / "X1C Complete Hotend Assembly" name this product. It agrees with the store page on the sizes ("Size: 0.2mm/ 0.4mm/ 0.6mm/ 0.8mm"), the materials ("Materials: Hardened steel / Stainless steel") and the max temperature (320 ℃); the per-option diameter and material stay with the store page's option values (official_variant). It states no dimensions, weight, flow rate or electrical value for this product. The 300°C rating of the "X1/P1 Series Hotend Silicone Sock" belongs to that separate product and is not stored here.

searched.title: Filament guide - Printer, Nozzle, AMS, Build Plate, Glue Compatibility and Required Parameters | Bambu Lab Wiki
searched.note: A general guide for every Bambu nozzle (it includes high-flow columns this product does not have), so none of its rows is stored as a spec of this product; it is used only to flag disagreements with the store page's own Filament Compatibility table (see the relations' conflict notes). Its nozzle guidelines also say to avoid stainless steel for particle-filled filaments (PLA Marble, PLA Sparkle), while the store table marks hardened steel "Optional" for them; on this product the only stainless option (0.2 mm) is "*NO" for those rows, so no relation is affected.

specs.value: Complete hotend: includes the nozzle, heater, thermistor, silicone sock and fan, for swaps without extra assembly.
specs.source_title: Introduction to Bambu Nozzles | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.locator: Types › X1/P1 Series Nozzle › "The X1/P1 series printer nozzles come in two types" › item 2
specs.quote: Complete hotend – includes the nozzle, heater, thermistor, silicone sock and fan, allowing quick and easy swaps without extra assembly.
specs.note: The wiki type "Complete hotend" is this page's Hotend Type value "Complete Hotend" (the compatibility table lists it as "X1C Complete Hotend Assembly"). The store's In the Box table lists the assembly as one item ("X1 Series Complete Hotend * 1").

specs.value: Nozzle only: just the metal part, without electronics; the printer's existing electronics are moved to the new nozzle.
specs.source_title: Introduction to Bambu Nozzles | Bambu Lab Wiki
specs.locator: Types › X1/P1 Series Nozzle › "The X1/P1 series printer nozzles come in two types" › item 1
specs.quote: Nozzle only – just the metal part, without electronics, ideal for basic replacements where the electronics can still be used and can be migrated to the new nozzle.
specs.note: Unverified: the wiki calls this type "Nozzle only" (its image caption: "single nozzle assembly"); it is matched to this page's value "Hotend" because the other type matches "Complete Hotend" by name. The store's In the Box table for "Hotend" adds a silicone sock, thermal grease and a retaining clip.
